## New in this release

RQ MOD 2.64.0 follows 2.62.2 and brings 2.63.0 with it (2.63.0 was not released on its own). Mods can now bring Flash animations of their own and put new pictures or colours on the game's 3D models, and three programs in the zip help make them.

### The programs, and what is new in them

- **rqmod-aff** (new, `xsystem4\rqmod-aff.exe`): a mod's Flash animations, on the command line.
  - `build` turns a folder of PNG frames (any drawing program's export) and WAV sounds into an `.aff` the game plays, at 1 to 30 frames a second, each sound started at its frame, and with `--size` on the stage of a game file it takes the place of.
  - `check` reads an `.aff` or a SWF and lists every problem the game would meet, each with its frame and what to do.
  - `unpack` writes a plain SWF that other viewers open, also straight from the game's archive, and `list` names the game's files as `rq.image` takes them.

  Guide: [Animations](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/animations).
- **[Rance Browser 1.3.0](https://github.com/RQ-Modding/rance-browser/releases/tag/v1.3.0)** (`xsystem4\rance-browser.exe`; 1.0.1 in RQ MOD 2.62.2):
  - **The Flash tab plays a file as the game plays it**: its frames at the game's 30 a second, its actions, its sounds and its blend modes, and says whether the game would play it, each problem with its frame. It opens a mod's own `.swf` or `.aff` from disk (a button, or a file dropped on the window), with its `rq.image.add_flash` and `rq.image.play_flash` lines.
  - **A new 3D models tab**: the game's 647 models (the monsters and figures, the rooms, the fight backgrounds, the props) drawn by a copy of RQ MOD's own 3D renderer, so as the game draws them; a monster's motions as a fight plays them, on one of the game's fight backgrounds with its shadow and the fight's camera. **Export the model as glTF (.glb)** opens it in Blender with its textures, skeleton and motions.
  - **A model's textures**: listed as `rq.image.textures` lists them. **Try a PNG...** and **Colours...** show a picture, or colours by numbers, on the model as the engine would draw them (refused in the engine's own words where it would refuse them), with the `rq.image.texture` or `rq.monster.model` line to copy. **Save the UV map...** gives the shapes to paint over.

  Guides: [Looking through the game's files](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/file-browser), [Learning 3D](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/learning-3d), [Game models in Blender](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/game-models), [A monster in new colours](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/model-textures).
- **[RQ Scene Editor 1.0.1](https://github.com/RQ-Modding/rq-scene-editor/releases/tag/v1.0.1)** (`xsystem4\rq-scene-editor.exe`): the world map's place tag plays on Rance Browser's Flash player, at the game's 30 frames a second (it played slower, at the file's own 24) and drawn as the game draws it; Play from here's sounds come from Rance Browser's mixer. Guide: [Writing scenes in the scene editor](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/scene-editor).

### For mods

- **Flash animations of a mod's own** (2.63.0): `rq.image.add_flash` puts an `.aff` or a SWF in the place of one of the game's (a skill's effect, a mark, a cut-in) or under a new name, checked first by the game's rules; `rq.image.play_flash` plays one on screen; `rq.sprite.new{ flash = ... }` makes a sprite that plays one, with its sounds. Guide: [Animations](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/animations).
- **New pictures and colours on the game's 3D models** (2.64.0): `rq.image.texture` puts a PNG (a PNG per frame for an animated texture) or colours by numbers in HSL on one of the game's textures, wherever a model uses it; `rq.image.textures` lists a model's textures; `rq.monster.model`'s `textures` gives a mod's monster model pictures of its own. Guide: [A monster in new colours](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/model-textures).
- Every kind of PNG for `rq.image.add`, `replace` and `flash_bitmap` (16-bit, grey, palette, interlaced); a broken one is refused with the reason instead of closing the game.

### For players

- RQ MOD works in a game folder whose name has accents or Japanese characters (`Coleção`, `ゲーム`): there a mod's music did not play, the settings mods keep were not kept and screenshots were not saved, and in a folder whose name the system's code page cannot spell no mod loaded.
- The game's battle effects, marks and cut-ins with soft edges look as the game's art draws them: their glows came out darker.
- A Flash file, the game's or a mod's, can no longer close the game by being cut short or strange.
- RQ MOD's programs use Windows' Universal C Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 have (Windows 7 and 8.1 with Microsoft's update for it).
- A mod with no `id` in its `mod.json`, in a folder named outside ASCII, now has its folder's name in UTF-8 as its id, so the settings it kept under the old one are not found (an `id` in `mod.json` keeps them).
